description:
Combining generous living space with an incredibly convenient location, this two-bedroom end-terraced home is a great choice for anyone wanting to enjoy city living without compromising on parking or outdoor space.

The property benefits from its own driveway, a particularly spacious lounge opening onto the rear garden, a fitted kitchen and two well-proportioned bedrooms. Whether you are a first-time buyer, commuter or investor, the layout is practical and easy to maintain, while still providing plenty of room to relax and entertain.

Midland Place is ideally situated within walking distance of Derby railway station and the city centre, placing shops, restaurants, leisure facilities, popular long-established pubs and major transport links close at hand. Offered for sale with no onward chain, this is a conveniently located home ready for its next chapter.

ENTRANCE HALL

Accessed via the front entrance door, with stairs rising to the first floor and doors leading to the kitchen and lounge. The hallway also benefits from useful understairs storage, ideal for coats, shoes and everyday essentials.

KITCHEN
9'2" x 6'2" (2.80m x 1.87m)

Positioned at the front of the property and fitted with a range of wall and base units, work surfaces, a sink and space for appliances.

LOUNGE
14'8" x 12'2" (4.48m x 3.70m)

A generously sized reception room with plenty of space for both relaxing and dining. Patio doors open directly onto the rear garden, bringing in plenty of natural light and creating an easy connection between the indoor and outdoor spaces.

FIRST-FLOOR LANDING

Providing access to both bedrooms, the bathroom and a useful airing cupboard.

MAIN BEDROOM
12'7" x 12'2" (3.84m x 3.70m)

An impressive double bedroom positioned at the rear of the property, offering ample space for bedroom furniture.

BEDROOM TWO
10'6" x 6'2" (3.19m x 1.87m)

A versatile second bedroom with fitted wardrobes, ideal as a guest room, child’s bedroom or dedicated home office.

BATHROOM
5'8" x 5'7" (1.73m x 1.70m)

Fitted with a three-piece suite comprising a bath, wash hand basin and WC.

OUTSIDE

The property benefits from driveway parking—an especially valuable feature for a home so close to Derby city centre and the railway station.

To the rear is an enclosed garden accessed directly from the lounge, providing a private space for relaxing and entertaining. A rear access gate offers practical access for bins and bicycles.

LOCATION

Midland Place is perfectly positioned for those wanting convenience and a lively city lifestyle. Derby railway station and the city centre are both within walking distance, providing easy access to shops, restaurants, leisure facilities and regular rail services.

The area is also home to several long-established and popular pubs, offering welcoming places to enjoy live bands, drinks and the local social scene. This well-connected location is particularly appealing to commuters, first-time buyers and investors looking for a home close to everything Derby has to offer.

NO ONWARD CHAIN

The property is offered for sale with no onward chain, helping to provide the potential for a more straightforward purchase.

Disclaimer

All representations contained in the particulars are based on details supplied by the Seller. Your Conveyancer is legally responsible for ensuring any purchase agreement fully protects your position. Please inform us if you become aware of any information being inaccurate.

Money Laundering Regulations

Should a purchaser(s) have an offer accepted on a property marketed by Yopa, they will need to undertake an identification check and asked to provide information on the source and proof of funds. This is done to meet our obligation under Anti Money Laundering Regulations (AML) and is a legal requirement.  We use a specialist third party service together with an in-house compliance team to verify your information. The cost of these checks is £82.50 +VAT per purchase, which is paid in advance, when an offer is agreed and prior to a sales memorandum being issued. This charge is non-refundable under any circumstances.

Within walking distance of Derby railway station
Convenient access to Derby city centre
Generously sized lounge with patio doors to the garden
Useful understairs storage and fitted wardrobes

Ideal for first-time buyers, commuters or investors
